the NMT system with post processing out performs the NMT system without post processing.
the post processed output of the NMT system has better BLEU score than the output of the N MT system.
the neural machine translation output for the aviation domain in Bengali is better when it is post processed using phraseology converter and the transliteration tool.

the design and implementation a NMT system for a new domain in Bengali.
the implementation of an English to Bengali NMT model for aviation domain.
the development of a novel NMT system for the aviation domain for Bengali.

the proposed model can be used for machine translation in Bengali for the aviation domain.
the NMT output with post processing is the best possible output for the English to Bengali translation system for the aviation domain.
the NMT model is capable of producing a better translation output for the aviation domain in Bengali.

we have successfully implemented a NMT system for a unique domain in Bengali.
we have successfully designed and implemented an aviation specific NMT system in Bengali.
